statements.markdown: **Corollary 8.7 (Half-LCM horizon).** *Let $J\ge2$ and $L_J:=\mathrm{lcm}(2,3,\ldots,J)$. For every $n\ge\max\{4,L_J/2+1\}$ there is an $M\in[n,2n-2]$ with $\mu_J(M)<11/15$. Thus witness exclusion leaves only the finite window $[4,L_J/2]$ to check.*
